import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a DataFrame from the provided data
data = {
    'StichtagDat': ['2024-12-31', '2025-12-31', '2019-12-31', '2020-12-31', '2021-12-31'],
    'AlterV10Lang': ['30- bis 39-Jährige'] * 5,
    'SexLang': ['männlich'] * 5,
    'KreisLang': ['Kreis 7', 'Kreis 7', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10'],
    'AnzHunde': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a count plot
sns.countplot(data=df, x='KreisLang', hue='SexLang', palette='viridis')

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Kreis and Sex', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Kreis', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Sex', fontsize=10)
